title: MV Leave State all allies effect (YanFly plugins)

posts.author: Prostovich
posts.body:
I couldn't find anywhere a script call or smth like this for YanFly's Lunatic Mode so asking here.
There is a skill which applies a state to a user with some effects only for this user. But after state expires, it should restore MP to all allies.
I have this code:
Code:
<Custom Leave Effect>
var mpheal = 2;
user.gainMp(+mpheal );
</Custom Leave Effect>
And I just need to replace
user
.gainMp. What should be here?
I tried to use some tags from MV/MZ Script Call table (allMembers, aliveMembers, etc), but nothing works.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from RPG Maker MV Support to Javascript/Plugin Support.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
Prostovich said:
And I just need to replace
user
.gainMp
Click to expand...
Code:
user.friendsUnit().aliveMembers().forEach(member => member.gainMp(mpheal));

posts.author: Prostovich
posts.body:
Robro33 said:
Code:
user.friendsUnit().aliveMembers().forEach(member => member.gainMp(mpheal));
Click to expand...
Works. Big thanks!
